title: HUACACHINA BUGGY & SANDBOARDING
description: Pure adrenaline in the Huacachina desert. Enjoy thrilling buggy rides through the dunes and slide down the sand with sandboarding.

itinerary.title: Adventure in Huacachina
itinerary.description: We meet in Huacachina, the desert oasis. We start with an exciting high-speed buggy ride through the dunes. Then we'll practice sandboarding on the highest dunes. We finish with a spectacular sunset from the top.

recommendations: Wear clothes that can get dirty
Bring sunglasses and a bandana for sand
Not suitable for people with back problems
